widgets_values: Restore this historical head-and-shoulders portrait conservatively. Repair scratches, fading, compression, and lost fine detail. Preserve the person's exact identity, facial geometry, expression, hairstyle, clothing, pose, camera angle, and crop. Keep period-authentic texture. For monochrome or sepia material, restore plausible natural color. Do not stylize.
